dialogues.speaker: Riqueti
dialogues.text: We should ask ourselves this honestly — if we did work at normal efficiency and with the usual workload at Maison Gestion, how much would we be able to do?

dialogues.speaker: Riqueti
dialogues.text: I never thought about any of this when I was with the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol. Only when I grew older and transferred to the Maison Gestion did I have more and more questions.
